title: Safety of Cultured Allogeneic Adult Umbilical Cord or Placental Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cells for PCOS
official: Safety of Cultured Allogeneic Adult Umbilical Cord or Placental Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cells for the Treatment of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
summary: This trial will study the safety and efficacy of cultured allogeneic adult umbilical cord or placental derived mesenchymal stem cells delivered intravenously for the treatment of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome.

interventions.name: Cultured allogeneic adult umbilical cord or placental derived mesenchymal stem cells

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

• Ultrasound documented poly cystic ovary syndrome

Exclusion Criteria:

* Active infection
* Active cancer
* Chronic multisystem organ failure
* Pregnancy
* Clinically significant abnormalities on pre-treatment laboratory evaluation
* Medical condition that would (based on the opinion of the investigator) compromise patient's safety
* Continued drug abuse
* Previous organ transplant
* Hypersensitivity to sulfur
* Inability to supply proper informed consent
sponsor: The Foundation for Orthopaedics and Regenerative Medicine
